payload.text: In two sentences, what is the difference between latency and throughput? Answer from your own knowledge and use no tools.

data.text: Latency is how long it takes to complete one operation, while throughput is how many operations can be completed per unit of time. A system can have low latency but low throughput, or high latency but high throughput, depending on its concurrency and batching.

payload.text: Now, in two sentences, name one case where improving one of them makes the other worse. Again use no tools.

data.text: Reducing latency by processing each request immediately can hurt throughput because it prevents batching, which would handle more requests per unit of time. For example, sending database queries one at a time may speed up an individual query’s response but reduce the total number of queries completed per second.
